title: Identification and Quantitation of Lipid Mediators via LC-MS/MS
author: Roman A. Colas
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.21203/rs.3.pex-1147/v1

steps.title: Plasma Collection and Storage
steps.instruction: Collect blood with anti-coagulant and centrifuge human peripheral blood at 1500 x g for 10 min at room temperature to collect plasma. Store plasma at -80ºC until analysis.

steps.title: Prepare Internal Standard Methanol
steps.instruction: Prepare methanol containing internal standard (methanol-IS; 500pg in 2mL of methanol/0.5mL of plasma) consisting of d4-PGE2, d5-RvD2, d5-LXA4, d4-LTB4, d8-5S-HETE, d5-LTC4, d5-LTD4, and d5-LTE4. Place the methanol-IS on ice for 45 min.

steps.title: Protein Precipitation
steps.instruction: Perform protein precipitation on plasma samples.

substeps.instruction: Place 1mL of plasma in a 15 mL falcon tube.
Add 4 mL of cold methanol-IS.
Vortex for 10 sec.
Keep samples at -20°C for a minimum of 45 min.
Centrifuge samples at 2000 x g for 10 min at 4°C.

steps.title: Initial Solvent Evaporation
steps.instruction: Concentrate the supernatant using a TurboVap LV.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 2.5 mL of supernatant into round bottom borosilicate tubes (store remaining samples at -80ºC).
Place samples in TurboVap LV with water bath at 37°C under a gentle flow of Nitrogen gas.
Evaporate until the final volume of methanol is less than 1mL.
Place samples on ice (do not store; process ASAP).

steps.title: Extrahera System Setup
steps.instruction: Prepare the Extrahera automated extraction system.

substeps.instruction: Add new Solid-phase ISOLUTE C18 500 mg/3 mL columns to the rack.
Add new collection tubes and fill solvent stock bottles.
Turn on the vacuum pump (Adjust pressure: 3 bar for ¼ plate, 4 bar for ½ plate, 6 bar for full plate).
Turn on the nitrogen supply (Adjust pressure: 6 bar for ¼ plate, 8 bar for ½ plate, 10 bar for full plate).
Fill the tips.

steps.title: Solid Phase Extraction (SPE)
steps.instruction: Extract lipid mediators using C18 SPE columns on the Extrahera system.

substeps.instruction: Load samples on Extrahera and start the run.
Wash columns with 3 mL methanol.
Acidify samples by adding pH 3.5 water (HCl) to a final volume of 10 mL.
Load samples onto the C18 SPE columns.
Wash columns with 2 mL of water to remove acid.
Wash columns with 6 mL hexane to remove complex lipids.
Elute mediators into collection tubes using 5 mL methyl formate.
Elute conjugated mediators into separate collection tubes using 5 mL methanol.

steps.title: Fraction Recovery and Final Evaporation
steps.instruction: Recover fractions and evaporate solvents completely.

substeps.instruction: Transfer collected fractions to 15 mL falcon tubes.
Rinse collection tubes with 1.5 mL methanol and pool with the respective fraction.
Place samples in TurboVap LV (water bath 37°C, gentle Nitrogen flow).
Place an equal volume of methanol-IS (relative to extracted sample) into a separate 15 mL falcon tube in the evaporator as a recovery reference.
When ~95% of solvent has evaporated, rinse the wall with 2 mL methyl formate.
When ~95% of the remaining solvent is evaporated, rinse the wall with 2 mL methanol.
Leave in TurboVap LV until all solvent has evaporated.

steps.title: Sample Reconstitution and Vial Transfer
steps.instruction: Reconstitute the dried samples for LC-MS/MS injection.

substeps.instruction: Add 40 μL of methanol/water (1:1, vol/vol).
Vortex for 10 sec.
Immediately centrifuge samples at 2000 x g for 2 min at 4°C.
Transfer supernatant into borosilicate vial inserts placed in 1.5 mL Eppendorf tubes.
Centrifuge at 10000 x g for 10 sec at 4°C.
If no pellet is visible in the insert, transfer the insert into an injection tube.
Place samples in the automated injector ASAP (keep at 4°C until injection, do not freeze).

steps.title: LC-MS/MS Instrument Setup
steps.instruction: Configure the LC-MS/MS for the three different analysis modes.

substeps.instruction: Methyl formate fraction: Agilent Poroshell 120 EC-C18 (100x4.6x2.7 µm) at 50°C. Mobile phase: methanol/water/acetic acid. Ramp: 20:80:0.01 (initial) -> 50:50:0.01 (0.5 min) -> 80:20:0.01 (2-11 min) -> 98:2:0.01 (0.1 min) -> maintain 98:2:0.01 (5.4 min).

Methanol fraction: Agilent Poroshell 120 EC-C18 (100x4.6x2.7 µm) at 50°C. Mobile phase: methanol/water/acetic acid. Ramp: 20:80:0.5 (initial) -> 55:45:0.5 (0.2 min) -> 70:30:0.5 (5 min) -> 80:20:0.5 (2 min) -> 98:2:0.5 (3 min).
Chiral analysis: Chiralpak AD-RH (150x2.1x5 µm) at RT. Mobile phase: methanol/water/acetic acid 95:5:0.01 (v/v/v).
Include reference standards and 100% IS (40 µL injection) in the sequence.

steps.title: Mass Spectrometry (MRM) Configuration
steps.instruction: Set up Multiple Reaction Monitoring (MRM) on QTrap 5500 or 6500+.

substeps.instruction: Methyl formate fraction: Negative mode. Determine source parameters and MRM transitions (Q1/Q3, DP, EP, CE, CXP) via manual tune with standards.
Methanol fraction: Positive mode. Determine source parameters and MRM transitions via manual tune with standards.
Chiral analysis: Negative mode. Determine source parameters and MRM transitions via manual tune with standards.
Set data acquisition window to 90 seconds.

steps.title: MS/MS Spectral Data Collection (IDA-EPI)
steps.instruction: Use Information Dependent Acquisition (IDA)-triggered Enhanced Product Ion (EPI) scans for spectral information.

substeps.instruction: In the IDA Ion exclusion tab, list parent ions of internal standards to minimize interference.
Set assay polarity in the EPI scan window as appropriate.
Set m/z detection window: 100-400 (negative mode) or 100-680 (positive mode).

steps.title: Quantitation and Identification
steps.instruction: Identify and quantify lipid mediators (LMs) using standards and calibration curves.

substeps.instruction: Build quantitation method using standard reference mix and load samples.
Integrate internal standards and identify LMs by matching retention time (RT) to standards (max drift 0.05 seconds).
Verify peaks have at least 4 data points and > 2000 counts.
Match MS/MS spectra using Analyst Explore mode; a positive match requires minimum 6 diagnostic ions, including one backbone fragment.
Quantify using calibration curves (0, 0.78, 1.56, 3.12, 6.25, 12.5, 25, 50, 100, and 200 pg).
Use surrogate molecules for mediators where standards are unavailable.
